newsitem.title: USA: Hutchison Whampoa unit to sell $1 bln debt.
newsitem.headline: Hutchison Whampoa unit to sell $1 bln debt.

text.p: Hutchison Whampoa Limited unit Hutchison Whampoa Finance Ltd is expected to issue a US$1.0 billion global multi-tranche debt offering, corporate bond syndicate sources said on Tuesday.
The A3/A-plus rated four-part deal, which is expected to come via the 144a private placement market, was expected to include 10-, 20-, 30- and 40-year maturities, sources said.
Merrill Lynch & Co Inc and Goldman, Sachs & Co Inc were expected to jointly underwrite the deal, they said.
The roadshow was expected to be held this week in Hong Kong and next week in New York, syndicate players said.
The issuer is a wholly owned financing subsidiary of Hong Kong-based Hutchison Whampoa Ltd, its guarantor on the notes.
